conclusion_scope: KiCad technical-only mask/paste pads use their literal shape with zero mask/paste expansion. FreePCB2 padstacks default to no hole/inner copper, allow explicit zero outer copper and separate mask/paste records. Unnamed aperture pads therefore use unique non-copper/hole-free carrier labels, preserved in JSON with a loss. KiCad contact pads have no drill, one outer copper layer and no solder paste; connector attribute remains a loss. Duplicate native pin names can be enumerated, but component exporter still requires unique physical-number mapping. Native GUI/netlist/Gerber behavior remains unverified.
